reviews.title: AS2 foundation globals, display properties, TextRenderer, and Object/Date/arguments
reviews.summary: Implements and verifies AS2 publication settings (_quality, _highquality, toggleHighQuality, _focusrect, _soundbuftime, showRedrawRegions), MovieClip._lockroot/getSWFVersion/scale9Grid, Button class and properties, Stage.wmodeGPU, TextField render hints/getFontList, flash.text.TextRenderer, Date.getUTCYear, Object.__proto__/constructor/registerClass, and arguments.callee/caller.

entries.note: Shared 32-bit integer preference (default 5) is stored across global, display and getProperty/setProperty and reset on restart; Web Audio/HTML5 streaming does not throttle prebuffer duration by _soundbuftime.
Validates boolean enable and optional 24-bit RGB color in Rust publication settings; Canvas 2D repaints full frames and does not draw Flash dirty-region debug rectangles.

Shared 32-bit integer preference (default 5) is stored across global, display and getProperty/setProperty and reset on restart; Web Audio/HTML5 streaming does not throttle prebuffer duration by _soundbuftime.
Returns 8 for live AS2 MovieClip instances in NeoFlash's unified SWF8-level HTML5 publication; multi-version external SWF bytecode inspection is not implemented.

Validates and clones flash.geom.Rectangle (positive interior width and height) or clears to undefined on live instances; 9-slice vector mesh deformation during scaled Canvas 2D rendering is not applied yet.

AS2 Button constructor resolves in frame and class scripts (instanceof Button, subclassing, pointer states, _visible, depth/render/input properties); Button.enabled callback-only toggle remains separate from mouseEnabled.

Shared 32-bit integer preference (default 5) is stored across global, display and getProperty/setProperty and reset on restart; Web Audio/HTML5 streaming does not throttle prebuffer duration by _soundbuftime.

Validates and clones flash.geom.Rectangle (positive interior width and height) or clears to undefined on live instances; 9-slice vector mesh deformation during scaled Canvas 2D rendering is not applied yet.

Shared 32-bit integer preference (default 5) is stored across global, display and getProperty/setProperty and reset on restart; Web Audio/HTML5 streaming does not throttle prebuffer duration by _soundbuftime.
Boolean embedFonts flag is stored and reset per TextField in Rust; Canvas 2D renders loaded CSS/project font faces rather than gating rendering on embedded Flash glyph outlines.
Validates and stores 'normal' or 'advanced' per TextField in Rust; Canvas 2D uses browser font antialiasing rather than Flash Saffron CSM glyph rasterization.
Validates and stores 'none', 'pixel' or 'subpixel' per TextField in Rust; Canvas 2D uses browser font hinting rather than Flash Saffron pixel/subpixel grid fitting.
Validates finite numbers and clamps sharpness to [-400, 400] per TextField in Rust; Canvas 2D text rendering does not apply Flash Saffron glyph sharpness.
Validates finite numbers and clamps thickness to [-200, 200] per TextField in Rust; Canvas 2D text rendering does not apply Flash Saffron glyph stem thickness.

Returns normalized, deduplicated, sorted font family names from loaded document.fonts, authored project fonts and standard browser families; full OS font enumeration without browser permission is unavailable.
Static flash.text.TextRenderer class resolves in AS2 with Rust-backed displayMode, maxLevel and setAdvancedAntialiasingTable; Canvas 2D delegates subpixel/hint rasterization to the browser.
Validates and stores 'default', 'lcd' or 'crt' in Rust and resets on restart; Canvas 2D delegates LCD/CRT subpixel text rasterization to the browser.
Validates integer maxLevel in 0..=64 (default 4) in Rust and resets on restart; Canvas 2D does not generate Flash Saffron adaptive antialiasing mip tables.
Validates fontName, fontStyle ('none'/'bold'/'italic'), colorType ('dark'/'light') and bounded cutoff entries in Rust; Canvas 2D text rendering does not consume Flash Saffron cutoff tables.
